purpose: Handbook page for the Breuken domain.
details: One section per topic (bar, recognising, equivalent and simplifying, comparing, adding/subtracting, fraction of a number, fraction and decimal) with a learning-line table per year, the thinking errors and the cheat sheet. It follows the fixed work method of the main handbook page. Tables per school year and the list of thinking errors and the cheat sheet are generated by docs/tools/handleiding.py between auto markers; the screenshots show the 0.19 menus.
summary: Describes the six fraction topics and the fraction bar: recognising and shading, equivalent fractions and simplifying (with two bars after a mistake), comparing with < > =, adding and subtracting (same denominators in year 4, unlike in 5, lcm and mixed numbers in 6, negatives in m1), fraction of a number with dot groups, and fraction/decimal conversion; ends with the cheat sheet.
